answer_1.quote: We consider the document-to-slides generation task as a Query-Based Single-Document Text Summarization (QSS) task.
answer_1.outputs: Generated slide text content (abstractive summaries) and optionally recommended figures/tables.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE as the automatic evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a human evaluation to ask raters to evaluate the slides generated by BARTKeyword ... Participants rate along three dimensions with a 6-point Likert scale (1 strongly disagree to 6 strongly agree): • Readability ... • Informativeness ... • Consistency ...
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluated each generated slide on three criteria—Readability, Informativeness, and Consistency—using a 6-point Likert scale.
